name: application-chat-bubbles
title: Chat Bubbles
description: Five distinct, original conversation layouts for direct messages, support threads, team chat, and system activity feeds, each built as a customizable component you can plug your own messages into.
useWhen: Five distinct, original conversation layouts for direct messages, support threads, team chat, and system activity feeds, each built as a customizable component you can plug your own messages into.
avoidWhen: Avoid chat bubbles when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Chat Bubbles uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Provide meaningful alternative text for informative images and empty alt text for decorative images.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
